## Part B: Read one half-hourly file cleanly (30 min)

### B1. Look inside a zip

Each zip holds several CSV files. Unzip one and list them.

| File (pattern) | What is in it |
| --- | --- |
| `…_FLUXMET_HH_….csv` | Fluxes and meteorology every 30 minutes. **This assignment uses these.** |
| `…_FLUXMET_DD/WW/MM/YY_….csv` | The same variables as daily, weekly, monthly, yearly values |
| `…_ERA5_HH … YY_….csv` | ERA5 reanalysis weather downscaled to the site |
| `…_BIF_….csv` | Site and ancillary information (BADM): location, IGBP, canopy height, LAI, soil … |
| `…_BIFVARINFO_….csv` | For each variable: measurement height or depth, instrument |

Read the file name: `AMF_US-Ha1_FLUXNET_FLUXMET_HH_1991-2025_v1.3_r1.csv` = hub, site ID, product, dataset, time step, years, ONEFlux code version, run.


### B2. Read it in

Three things must be right: **−9999 is missing**, **time stamps are read as text and converted to dates**, and **one row is one half hour**.
The HH files have hundreds of columns; read only the ones you need.


```{r}
# defining variables which should be kept

keep <- c("TIMESTAMP_START", "TIMESTAMP_END", "TA_F", "SW_IN_F", "VPD_F", "P_F",
          "NETRAD", "G_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS_QC", "LE_F_MDS", "LE_F_MDS_QC",
          "NEE_VUT_REF", "NEE_VUT_REF_QC", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF")
```


```{r}
# defining the function

read_hh <- function(zip_file) {

  # get site ID from the ZIP filename
  site <- basename(zip_file) |>
    stringr::str_extract("[A-Z]{2}-[A-Za-z0-9]+")

  # locate FLUXMET_HH CSV file (inside ZIP file)
  hh_name <- grep(
    "FLUXMET_HH",
    unzip(zip_file, list = TRUE)$Name,
    value = TRUE
  )

  # read CSV (directly from the ZIP file)
  hh <- readr::read_csv(
    unz(zip_file, hh_name),
    na = "-9999",
    col_types = readr::cols(
      TIMESTAMP_START = "c",
      TIMESTAMP_END = "c",
      .default = "d"
    )
  )

  # convert timestamps
  hh <- hh |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      time = as.POSIXct(
        TIMESTAMP_START,
        format = "%Y%m%d%H%M",
        tz = "UTC"
      ),
      site = site
    )

  return(hh)
}
```

```{r}
# Read all five towers into one table

# Locate all ZIP files in data/raw/

zip_files <- list.files(
  "../data/raw",
  pattern = "\\.zip$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Read all towers and combine them
hh_all <- purrr::map_dfr(zip_files, read_hh)
```


```{r}
# Create processed data folder if it doesn't exist
#
dir.create("data/processed", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Save combined dataset

readr::write_csv(hh_all, "../data/processed/hh_all.csv")




```
